title: Micro Handoff Bridgeboard (Ad-hoc coverage & owners)
content:
Purpose: quick, low-friction tracker to map micro handoffs + who covers sundry runtime endpoints for short-lived launches/experiments. Not a canonical on-call — temporary coverage decals only (<= 14 days).

How to use: paste into Slack channel #ops-launch-lite, ping owners next business day. Keep one row per endpoint/route/policy. If owner unknown -> assign 'triage' and escalate to eng-sre lead.

Columns (spreadsheet view):
- Endpoint / Route
- Primary owner
- Backup owner
- Expected busy window (UTC)
- Coverage window (start / end)
- SLA target (p99 latency / availability)
- Quick mitigation plan (if degraded)
- Status (ok / monitoring / degraded / unknown)
- Notes / open questions

Current snapshot (ad-hoc rows pasted from quick inventory):
1) /api/v1/generate-chat (hosted) | Primary: Elliot Grant | Backup: Maya Reddy | Busy window: 15:00-19:00 UTC | Coverage: 2034-04-07 -> 2034-04-14 | SLA p99: 300ms / availability: 99.9% | Mitigation: failover to small-model-1 (route policy) + increase parallelism cap; cache common prefixes | Status: monitoring | Notes: load spike expected from partner pilot, verify autoscale policy for dedicated pools.

2) embeddings/v2/bulk (dedicated) | Primary: Jordan Lee | Backup: Samira Patel | Busy window: 02:00-06:00 UTC | Coverage: 2034-04-08 -> 2034-04-12 | SLA p99: 1200ms / availability: 99.5% | Mitigation: batch window extension + prewarm nodes; short-term quota bump requested | Status: ok | Notes: partner ingestion batch aligned to UTC midnight — confirm shard sizing.

3) private-deploy/customer-X/rerank (private) | Primary: Maya Reddy | Backup: Triage | Busy window: 08:00-10:00 UTC (APAC) | Coverage: 2034-04-06 -> 2034-04-18 | SLA p99: 500ms / availability: 99.95% | Mitigation: route to fallback-rerank-v1 hosted; alert channel ops-private | Status: unknown | Notes: KMS rotation scheduled during coverage window — risk flagged.

4) admin/query-insights (console) | Primary: Samira Patel | Backup: Elliot Grant | Busy window: 20:00-23:00 UTC | Coverage: 2034-04-09 -> 2034-04-11 | SLA p99: 250ms / availability: 99.9% | Mitigation: read-only fallback to cached snapshot + notify stakeholders | Status: monitoring | Notes: throttles observed in last run, small schema migration pending.

Open action items (short):
- [ ] Elliot: confirm dedicated pool autoscale thresholds for generate-chat by 2034-04-08. (linked: JIRA-8471)
- [ ] Jordan: validate embeddings shard plan and send short runbook (target 2034-04-07 EOD).
- [ ] Maya: confirm KMS rotation time with security and propose window shift or explicit disturbance plan (by 2034-04-06).
- [ ] Samira: post this tracker to #ops-launch-lite and add owners to the watch roster (immediate).

Notes to self / scratchpad:
- This sheet intentionally lightweight — avoid over-structuring, prefer phone numbers (pager ids) and 1-line mitigations.
- Question: do we need a temp SLA waiver for private-deploy customer-X while KMS rotates? If yes loop legal & security.
- Quick metric to watch: token-generation errors per minute + 95th lat during busy window.

Escalation paths (one-liners):
- If status flips to degraded -> escalate to eng-sre lead (Elliot) and product-ops PM (Samira).
- If customer-impacting (billing errors / data loss risk) -> page on-call and notify CSM.

Past changes log (short):
- 2034-04-05: initial seed created after pairing call with SEs and customer success.
- 2034-04-06: added private-deploy row after KMS schedule surfaced.
- 2034-04-09: adjusted generate-chat coverage window based on partner feedback.

Unresolved questions:
- Who owns temporary quota increases for Dedicated pools during partner pilots? (Ops or Sales finance?)
- Should we centralize these micro handoffs into a recurring lightweight rota doc? pros/cons listed below:
  - Pros: single place, predictable; Cons: increases friction for ad-hoc/one-off pilots.

Quick references (copy-paste for Slack):
- Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/OPS/Handoff+Playbook
- Current tracker: (this doc)
- Runbook for failover: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/ENG/Runtime+Failover+Runbook

If you take an owner slot: comment on the sheet with ETA and a 1-line mitigation. No silent ownership — if you can't cover, mark 'triage' and escalate.
